title: Hello Kitty Travel Mug With Handle Holding A Green Apple & Floral Design
descriptionText:
This charming travel mug features the iconic Hello Kitty holding a green apple and sporting a lovely floral design. The mug is perfect for any fan of the beloved character and is great for use at home or on the go. With its sturdy construction and comfortable handle, this mug is sure to become a favorite for years to come.

The mug is part of the Collectibles, Animation Art & Merchandise, Animation Merchandise, and Cups & Mugs categories on eBay, making it easy to find and purchase. Its green color and floral theme add a touch of whimsy to any collection or animation merchandise collection.
